text:
You’re looking for a niche AI platform that uses personalized recommendations to help businesses improve customer engagement and satisfaction through a monthly subscription model.

I can help build that kind of product. With 6 years of experience in machine learning and NLP, I work with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, XGBoost, pandas, and related AI tooling to turn business needs into practical systems that can be deployed and iterated on as a subscription offering.

One relevant project I’ve built was Telecom churn prediction for a confidential telecom client. I developed a monthly churn score for 380k subscribers, with per-customer SHAP reasons that the retention team could read. That model reached an AUC of 0.84 on a held-out quarter and delivered a top-decile lift of 3.1x. That experience is directly relevant here because it involved building a decision-support model that not only predicted outcomes, but also made those predictions usable for business users.

For your platform, I’d focus on building a recommendation engine that is tailored to business needs, with clear logic behind the recommendations and a structure that supports a recurring subscription model. Depending on your data and product direction, that could include segmentation, behavior-based personalization, or language-driven features that help businesses better understand and act on customer patterns. I’m comfortable working across classical machine learning and modern NLP approaches, so I can adapt the solution to the data you have available and the customer experience you want to deliver.

I also pay close attention to making ML systems maintainable, measurable, and understandable, since those qualities matter a lot in a product that businesses will pay for every month. If helpful, I can help think through how the recommendation output should be presented so it feels valuable to users from day one.

What type of business data will this platform use for personalization: customer behavior events, text content, or both?
